body.cap: Roland Busch, President and Chief Executive Officer of Siemens AG, will keynote CES 2024. | Courtesy of Consumer Technology Association (CTA)

body.x: The Consumer Technology Association (CTA) announced Roland Busch, President and Chief Executive Officer of Siemens AG, as a keynote speaker for CES® 2024.

Siemens’ Dr. Roland Busch will speak at 6:30 p.m. PT on Monday, January 8, 2024, in the Palazzo Ballroom at the Venetian. Dr. Busch will explore the extensive possibility that unfolds when people utilize the digital world to enhance reality and advocate for a visionary and sustainable future. Attendees can anticipate a transformative ALL-ON experience on Monday, January 8, 2024, at 6:30 p.m. PT in the Palazzo Ballroom at the Venetian.

“Our technologies operate behind the scenes, enabling everyday life—in the factories that create the cars we drive, in the buildings where we work, in the grids that feed green energy to our cities, and in the trains that connect them,” said Roland Busch, the President and Chief Executive Officer of Siemens AG. “I am excited to address the global tech community at CES 2024 and highlight how the latest digital technologies enable companies to transform our every day.”

With a 175-year history in innovative technology, Siemens said the company continues to evolve and flourish in today’s changing world. Siemens has recently announced more than $2 billion in investments in its operations and R&D as it serves economies across the globe. Specializing in industrial software and automation, Siemens continued that its expertise in technologies - AI, blockchain, cloud, edge computing, and digital twin software - converges to create an innovative portfolio for businesses of all sizes to revolutionize industries, infrastructure, and mobility. Siemens then emphasized its vision extension into pioneering the forthcoming industrial metaverse.

“Siemens drives innovation across many of the products and services we use daily—from transportation, infrastructure, and industry to consumer goods, as well as food and beverages,” said Gary Shapiro, President and CEO of CTA. “We can’t wait to see how Siemens and its customers are shaping the future of digital transformation to create an inclusive and sustainable future.”

Siemens said its technology empowers customers to transform the industries that form today’s backbone of economies: industry, infrastructure, and transportation. It also highlighted its focus on sustainability by mentioning its 2015 carbon neutrality commitment by 2030. It also underlined its dedication to digital evolution, evident with the Siemens Xcelerator launched last year - an open digital business platform created to accelerate digital transformation across diverse industries.

Dr. Busch joins CEOs from L’Oréal, Walmart, and Nasdaq as CES 2024 keynote speakers, reinforcing a shared commitment to societal impact through technology and human security. Attendees will glimpse how Siemens continues to stretch the boundaries of innovation, reiterating its status as one of the world’s leading tech companies.
CES 2024 takes place from January 9-12 in Las Vegas, Nevada. Registration is now open.
